testimony.subject: Fee patent receipt and current status of allotted land
testimony.key_claims: Myrtle Last, age 48, is a Rosebud Sioux allottee who received a fee patent for her land (allotment 5406) delivered at her home in Shubert, Nebraska. She did not apply for the patent. She does not remember signing a receipt. She did not protest the patent. She still owns the land and has not sold or mortgaged it. Her health is yes but she is not strong. She has two sons, Albert (23) and Harvey (26), who are dependent on her and still live with her. She is supported by her husband.
